name: Houthis (Ansar Allah)
callout_language: Yemeni Arabic (northern highland dialects); tribal and religious honorifics in radio traffic.

doctrine.summary: Ansar Allah, known as the Houthis after its founding family, is a Zaydi Shia movement from Saada in northern Yemen led by Abdul-Malik al-Houthi. It took Sanaa in September 2014, fought a Saudi- and UAE-led coalition from 2015 (UN-brokered truce from April 2022) and controls most of northern Yemen's population. Its forces mix tribal fighters, a large body of former Yemeni Army units and equipment taken over in 2014-2015 (T-55, T-62, T-72, BMP and BTR vehicles, artillery), mass-produced technicals, and an Iranian-supported missile, drone and naval-attack capability. From November 2023 it attacked Red Sea shipping and Israel, drawing US, UK and Israeli strikes. In 2026 it joined Iran's war, imposed a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia (July), and in September 2026 took Mocha, the rest of the Red Sea coast and Perim Island at Bab al-Mandab, with the Saudi-backed government reportedly recovering some ground. In the game the Houthis are the best-equipped early-to-mid enemy in yemen_red_sea: mountain and coastal infantry with technicals, old army armour, drones and explosive boats as hazards.
doctrine.fireteam: Light-infantry groups of 6-12 with PKM and RPG; ex-army units keep Soviet-style sections and vehicle crews. In game: 8 in battle-buddy pairs.
tactics: Mountain ambushes from terraced slopes and wadis on road columns
Technical shoot-and-scoot with ZU-23 and DShK pickups, using the ZU-23 against ground targets
Snipers and machine guns in stone villages and on ridgelines
Drone spotting and one-way attack drones as AI hazard abilities
Explosive and armed fast boats as coastal hazards; anti-ship missile launches as off-map events
Roadside IED and landmine fields as telegraphed map hazards (Yemen is heavily mined)
Old army tanks dug in as static fire points

camo.name: Tribal civilian dress (thobe, jacket, shawl)
camo.use: Tribal fighters; jacket over a thobe with a shawl and a janbiya belt

rifleman: G3-pattern rifles from Yemeni army stocks (7.62x51mm)

launchers: Kornet and Dehlavieh (Iranian Kornet copy) ATGMs [not_in_game: AI threat only]
Toophan / Konkurs-type ATGMs [not_in_game: AI threat only]
SPG-9 recoilless gun on technicals [not_in_game: vehicle weapon]

body_armor.notes: Mostly chest rigs; ex-army units sometimes wear old steel helmets and soft vests. Game: none-to-light (proposed).

vehicles.notes: ZU-23-2 on pickups, used against ground and air targets; a common Houthi image.
Hilux pickups for moving tribal fighters.
Land Cruiser 70-series pickups and SUVs, often with a mounted gun.
The Houthi 'Waid' is a Shahed-136-type one-way attack drone; the Samad series is a longer-range Houthi type. Off-map hazard.
Quadcopters and small drones for spotting and munition drops on front lines. AI hazard ability.
Fibreglass skiffs as armed or explosive boats used against shipping; game hazard only.
Ex-Yemeni Army T-55s (and T-62s) used as dug-in fire points and support tanks.
Ex-Yemeni Army BMP-2s (also BMP-1s and BTR-60/80s).
Ex-Yemeni Army T-72 (T-72M-type, catalogue family file); few remain.
SPG-9 recoilless guns on pickups for fire support.

unit_templates.name: Fast boat team (coastal hazard)
unit_templates.notes: Armed skiff; the explosive-boat variant is a telegraphed hazard the player must stop at range.

support_assets: One-way attack drone hazard (Waid / Samad types)
Anti-ship missile or drone launch (off-map event, coastal maps)
Mortars and old army artillery (D-30, M-46) as off-map fire
Landmine and IED fields as map hazards
notes: The Houthis were designated a Foreign Terrorist Organization by the US in 2025 (re-designation after a 2021 revocation); they are the de facto authority in Sanaa and most of northern Yemen, opposed by the internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council government and its allies (Saudi-backed forces, the UAE-linked Southern Transitional Council, Tareq Saleh's National Resistance on the west coast). Iran supplies missile, drone and weapons components; seizures of Iranian shipments are well documented. From November 2023 they attacked merchant ships (seizing the Galaxy Leader and sinking several ships) and fired at Israel; a US-Houthi truce on shipping (May 2025) did not cover Israel. Status 2026: joined Iran's war from March 2026, naval blockade of Saudi Arabia from July, attacks on Saudi-linked ships in August, and in September 2026 captured Mocha, the remaining Red Sea coast and Perim Island at Bab al-Mandab, with Saudi airstrikes in response. AQAP and the Houthis are enemies, though a UN panel reported limited tactical coordination in 2024; al-Shabaab contacts (arms) were also reported by UN experts; both values are low-confidence. Game framing: mid-tier enemy in yemen_red_sea (Captain's brief allows mid), the theatre's main conventional-style opponent.
proposed: fast_boat explosive variant as a telegraphed hazard
